response.text: The fix was changing `start + perPage - 1` → `start + perPage` in the `items.slice()` call. The `- 1` was cutting off the last item of each page, so `[1,2], [3,4], [5]` became incorrect slices. Removing the `- 1` makes slices include all items up to the specified page size.
